== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Venomous [[green madra]] is a toxic, corrosive energy associated with specific [[Paths]] and entities. Originating from the swamps as an adaptation to the corruption found in the Desolate Wilds{{!}}Wilds, this [[madra]] draws its power from various forms of [[poison]] and acid. It is frequently utilized by the [[Sandviper sect]], appearing in many forms such as corrosive awls, toxic auras that create deadly fogs, and even leathery birds that trail fog. When used as a [[technique]], it can manifest as projectiles like arrows or arrowheads, and its effects on flesh are compared to the damage caused by a hot coal on paper. Beyond physical [[destruction]], certain variations of this energy—specifically [[Remnant madra]]—can attack a person's soul in addition to their physical body. In certain ritualistic contexts, this [[madra]] is linked to [[sacred beasts]]. To harness it, a practitioner may allow themselves to be bitten by a beast and then use their own [[madra]] to guide the venom, which burns channels through the body. This process requires the individual to remain conscious and consume the beast's [[blood]] to slow the [[poison]]'s progress toward vital organs. While extremely painful and potentially lethal, successfully guiding the venom can lead to healing once a person reaches the [[Iron]] level.}}
